classification.difficultyReason: The supplied formula and substitution scaffold guide the calculation; the main decision is recognising that the 12 cm diameter must be halved before squaring, followed by rounding.

content.prompt: Complete to calculate the volume of the cylinder to the nearest cubic cm.

Bottom ellipse has a dashed rear/upper arc and solid front/lower arc. Vertical side silhouettes are solid.

Upright cylinder with a complete grey top ellipse and a grey gradient curved surface. Height “15.1 cm” is on the right.
